exposure: emergent prelabor cesarean delivery vs non-emergent birth
cohort: Kidney and liver transplant recipients at >20 weeks gestation
finding: Emergency prelabor cesarean delivery in kidney and liver transplant recipients was associated with increased neonatal composite morbidity but not severe maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Almost one-third of kidney and liver transplant recipients admitted antepartum had an emergency prelabor cesarean delivery, and 63% of this cohort delivered outside of a transplant center.
